metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the easiest ways to SELF CRACK your thumb and hands. 

This video will focus on self mobilizing the joints of the hands and fingers to get that satisfying POP, crack, or release that we're looking for.

And we'll do this in a SIMPLE, straightforward step-by-step guide that will focus on:

Carpal bones and carpal tunnel syndrome (including the lunate and scaphoid)
Metacarpals
Thumb (including the base of the thumb joint)
Knuckles
Fingers or phalanges

All of these easy exercises are safe, effective and can give quick thumb, hand, knuckle and finger pain relief, even in as little as 30 SECONDS!

WATCH NOW and learn the best ways to self crack your thumb! 

CHAPTERS:
0:00 Intro
0:38 Carpal Bones Self Adjustment (Lunate and Scaphoid) 
2:54 Metacarpal Self Mobilization
5:38 Thumb Self Cracking
8:35 Safe Finger and Knuckle Popping
